en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing the massive stone fortification walls and towers of an old coastal city built on a hillside. A prominent round fortress dominates the upper part of the image, while defensive walls and bastions run down the slope beside clusters of Mediterranean-style houses and abundant trees. At the bottom margin in cursive script is the word "Dubrovnik," and on the right the phrase "Foto Tempo," indicating the photographer or studio.
